A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FALCON research and contain complete, readable main texts and appendices. Text extraction and visual inspection support matching the methods, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v4 reports original FALCON evaluations across retrieval, question answering, reasoning, and classification, together with ablations and robustness experiments.

after.justification: v5 retains those original experiments and adds FALCON results for VQA and NLVR2 under 4M-image pretraining in Table 13.

M1.justification: The quantile-based scheduler, Beta-distribution MLP, mini-batch construction, loss-reduction training signal, and BLIP-2/SigLIP-2 adaptations remain unchanged. Section 3 and Algorithms 1–2 describe the same procedures.

E1.justification: Table 13 uses VQA and NLVR2, already evaluated in Table 1, and the existing 4M pretraining coverage. It adds results under another pretraining configuration without introducing a new dataset, task, domain, or input scenario.

E2.justification: New Table 13 expands the reported VQA/NLVR2 comparisons to include UNITER, OSCAR, VILLA, ViLT, and TCL alongside ALBEF, GRIT-VLP, and MAFA. OSCAR and VILLA were absent from v4's comparisons; existing tables retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Table 13 adds a 4M-image pretraining configuration for VQA/NLVR2 comparisons, complementing the COCO-only pretraining comparison in Table 1. Existing evaluation splits, metrics, and protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The search-space, objective, and instance-level ablations, baseline sweeps, caption-noise and DataComp analyses, learning curves, and qualitative cases are retained. Table 13 adds benchmark scores rather than a new ablation or robustness analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests. Table 13 follows the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Existing table values and plotted findings are unchanged. New Table 13 reports, for example, FALCON VQA test-std of 75.78 versus MAFA's 75.75 and NLVR2 test-P of 82.28 versus 82.08. These are added 4M-pretraining results, not same-setting improvements over v4's COCO-only results.

T1.justification: The similarity-quantile definitions, scheduler objective, and mathematical updates in Equations (1)–(3) are unchanged. No new assumptions, proofs, theorems, or derivations appear.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty and effectiveness claims for adaptive hard/false-negative scheduling across ALBEF, BLIP-2, and SigLIP-2. Table 13 supplies additional evidence without redefining those claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning caption noise, pretrained false-negative filters, and asymmetric SigLIP-2 gains remain unchanged. The limitations concerning auxiliary objectives and signals from both encoders are retained in Appendix 9 of v4, renumbered Appendix 10 in v5.

D1.justification: Appendix 8.4 in v5 specifies that SigLIP-2 continued pretraining on MSCOCO lasts five epochs; v4's corresponding Appendix 7.4 does not specify this duration. This is newly disclosed information, without evidence that the experiment itself changed.

R1.justification: v5 adds references for VILLA and OSCAR supporting Table 13. The substantive related-work discussion and positioning against heuristic sampling, pretrained filtering, and learning-to-optimize approaches remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v5 adds an acknowledgments section, renumbers appendix sections, moves the existing warm-start explanation into the implementation subsection, and makes small wording and author-name edits. The main narrative remains substantially intact.

P2.justification: v5 adds Table 13 and a cross-reference in Table 2's caption, improves rendering sharpness of qualitative Figures 5, 9, and 10, and adjusts column spacing and reference presentation. The existing figures retain their examples, plots, and substantive content.

improvement.justification: Table 13 modestly strengthens empirical completeness by adding VQA/NLVR2 comparisons under 4M pretraining. The five-epoch SigLIP-2 disclosure improves reproducibility, and sharper figures improve readability. The new margins over MAFA are small and lack uncertainty estimates, so the additional evidence provides limited strengthening rather than a substantial advance in overall quality.
